human_checks: real-hardware verification for input-state mechanisms that synthetic libei input cannot prove reliable

coverage.description: Experimental external Linux test harness that isolates a mod, launches Skyrim under gamescope, injects input, takes screenshots and polls structured probe/game state.
known_gaps: not yet validated by Agent OS against the user's own machine/profile
headless/libei held input is not equivalent to every real hardware held-input state
upstream currently documents a 1.7.104 Start On Save autoload dependency incompatibility in its bundled setup; menu boot workaround exists
project is third-party experimental infrastructure, not an official Skyrim test framework
coverage.denominator_probe: Replay steps planned vs executed/passed/failed; probe assertions vs expected; profile files/plugins vs generated isolated profile.

requires_confirmation_for: initial conversion of a real Data directory into the tool's symlink-managed profile layout
safety.sandbox_or_scope: Development/test installation only. Never point autonomous tests at a primary long-play save.

verification.version_probe: skytest source commit + Skyrim/SKSE/Address Library status
verification.output_readback: Use probe gates/trace and A/B vanilla control; transport success alone is not a test pass.

ai.context_cost_notes: Promising implementation candidate for G26 runtime assertions, but keep experimental until local fixtures mutation-test the harness.

evidence.notes: Upstream documents test/replay/ready/shot/drive/stop, vanilla A/B control, gamescope headless mode, save isolation and SkytestProbe state gates.
